text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while training with Mejiro<n>Dober...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Aha! So this is where you two were!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Tazuna? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to deliver good news!<n>The thing is,
because of how well you<n>did during your classic
year...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA has selected you as the<n>classic-year
Goddess!<n>Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The title of Goddess is awarded to<n>those who run in
races like the<n>Hanshin J.F., Triple Tiara, and Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The accolade is awarded to one racer<n>in each year:
junior, classic, and<n>senior. It's a huge honor for
Mejiro<n>Dober to be selected to represent her<n>year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Me? I'm the classic-year Goddess!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! ♪ The award<n>ceremony is going to
be held in a few<n>days, so don't forget to prepare a
speech!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'd better help me prepare<n>my speech
after training today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'd better help me prepare<n>my speech
after training today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On the day of the award ceremony...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On the day of the award ceremony...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's hear a word from this<n>year's
classic-year Goddess, Mejiro<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober stands tall onstage,<n>meeting the
wave of applause and<n>flashing cameras with pride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to express my sincere<n>gratitude for being
chosen as the<n>recipient of such a magnificent
award.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, I hope my<n>performance continues
to live up to<n>this achievement...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do my best so I can stand on<n>this stage
once again during my<n>senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The hall erupts with renewed<n>applause and
admiring murmurs at<n>Mejiro Dober's words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I think I might have oversold myself...
choice_data_list: I thought it was pretty cool of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I wasn't trying to be cool! I just<n>wanted to make
my determination<n>clear to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
C-cool?! Me?! I was just trying to<n>make my
determination clear to<n>everyone! Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't exactly take those words<n>back... Just help
me make them come<n>true, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't take them back, so I have to<n>make those
words a reality now.<n>Let's do our best, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's growth is evident to<n>everyone as
the award ceremony<n>comes to an end!
